## Who Is Bhavya Jain?

Bhavya Jain is an independent AI builder and web developer who creates modern
websites, AI-powered products, automation systems and software tools. His
current areas of exploration include AI engineering, large language model
applications, retrieval-augmented generation, Model Context Protocol (MCP),
automation and full-stack web development.

## Selected Projects

1. GENZO — An AI ecosystem of web tools for creators, currently in planning.
2. AI VIBE CODEDX — An AI-first development environment concept focused on
   turning product ideas and structured prompts into working software.
3. GENCLIPPER — An AI-powered video clipping concept designed to identify
   useful moments from long-form video and transform them into short-form content.
4. TASKTRIBE — A task and productivity tracking project with structured tasks,
   progress tracking and a modern web interface.
5. MR MOMOS 99 — A modern restaurant website concept presenting menu, reviews,
   location and ordering experience.
